description: Successively eliminating any finite list of atoms preserves satisfiability.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Resolution.elimination_many_equisatisfiable.{u} {α : Type u} [DecidableEq α] (ps : List α)
  (Γ : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Resolution.ClauseSet α) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Resolution.Sat (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Resolution.eliminateMany ps Γ) ↔
    Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Resolution.Sat Γ
